{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Count and drop the six QA orders with revenue 999999.99
qa_count = (df['revenue'] == 999999.99).sum()
df = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Count and drop rows where customer_age == -1 (missing data)
missing_age_count = (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
df = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Filter to only converted orders
df_converted = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Compute mean age of converted customers
mean_age_converted = df_converted['customer_age'].mean()

# Print all key numbers
print(f'Number of QA orders removed: {qa_count}')
print(f'Number of missing age rows (age == -1) removed: {missing_age_count}')
print(f'Number of converted customers after filtering: {len(df_converted)}')
print(f'Mean age of converted customers: {mean_age_converted:.6f}')"}
